notes.title: Features and Notes on the Steam version
notes.notes:
■Support for Gamepad or Keyboard & Mouse

The Steam version of the game can be operated by gamepad or keyboard & mouse.

Screens that focus on gameplay, such as field movement and battles, can be controlled by gamepad.

For screens that cannot be used with the gamepad, such as controls after expanding the menu, please use the keyboard & mouse or use "Mouse Mode".

There are two types of Camera/Cursor Control: type A and type B.
This can be set in Settings > Detail > Controls > Camera/Cursor Control.

Type A
- Camera Controls: Mouse
- Cursor Controls: Left alt key (default) + mouse

Type B
- Camera Controls: Mouse drag
- Cursor Controls: Mouse

Please check the guide at the top of the screen for the corresponding buttons and keys.
All of these settings can be changed under Key Configuration.

▼Key Configuration
When operating with a gamepad, "Skill & Item Mode" and "Mouse Mode" are controls that must always be done while pressing different buttons.
Please note that it is not possible to assign these to a single button.

▼Fishing Function
If the control guide is on while fishing and during its settings, the relevant keys will be displayed.
Each action can be performed by pressing the corresponding key, or by using the mouse's cursor to click the icon.

▼Switching to Gampad
When switching the gamepad during gameplay, the key guide may not be switched immediately.

■Transferring Character from Other Platforms

We support cross-play, which allows players from all platforms (Steam, Android, Google Play Games, and iOS) to play with each other. To use your current account on another platform, however, you will need to transfer your account.
Before transferring your account, please read the transfer procedure and precautions on the FAQ site below.
 https://bnfaq.channel.or.jp/faq/detail/3045/4238 

▼Arcana Gems
Arcana Gems will be lost when you transfer your character to a different platform's version, so please use all of your Arcana Gems before transferring.

▼Boost Mode
The effect is only activated on the platform version you subscribe with.
If you subscribe on the Steam version and transfer your character to a different platform, the effect will not be applied.
If you subscribe on another platform version and transfer your character to the Steam version, the effect will not be applied.

■Other Notes

▼FPS
The Steam version supports up to 60FPS max.

▼VR Mode
The Steam version does not support VR mode.

▼Screenshot Function
You can choose to display or hide the UI when taking screenshots.
You can set this in Settings > Detail > Functions > Hide UI when taking screenshots.

▼For Those Using CPUs/GPUs by AMD
We have confirmed cases of reduced performance on some CPUs/GPUs made by AMD.
Please note that it may take some time for us to handle this issue, or we may not be able to handle the issue.
